SELECT
  c.customer_id,
  c.customer_name,
  c.email,
  p.product_name,
  ph.status AS payment_status,

  COUNT(cc.complaint_id) AS complaint_count,

  STRING_AGG(cc.complaint, ' | ') AS complaints
FROM customer c
JOIN payment_history ph 
  ON c.customer_id = ph.customer_id
JOIN products p 
  ON ph.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN customer_complaint cc 
  ON c.customer_id = cc.customer_id
GROUP BY
  c.customer_id,
  c.customer_name,
  c.email,
  p.product_name,
  ph.status;

SELECT 
    c.customer_id, 
    c.customer_name, 
    c.email, 
    p.product_id,
    p.product_name, 
    ph.payment_id,
    ph.status AS payment_status, 
    COUNT(cc.complaint_id) AS complaint_count, 
    STRING_AGG(cc.complaint, ' | ') AS complaints 
FROM customer c 
JOIN payment_history ph ON c.customer_id = ph.customer_id 
JOIN products p ON ph.product_id = p.product_id 
LEFT JOIN customer_complaint cc ON c.customer_id = cc.customer_id 
GROUP BY 
    c.customer_id, 
    c.customer_name, 
    c.email, 
    p.product_id,
    p.product_name, 
    ph.payment_id,
    ph.status;
